note: Boonville, on the Black River, between Tug Hill and the Adirondacks. Daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal (summer and winter) and annual rentals; grass + wooded sites, RV sites on a rise (not waterfront). On snowmobile trail 7C. The website works only over plain http. --Claude
summary: Operator's website (live over http, Wayback captures to June 2026) confirms full-hookup camper sites (water/sewer now manual), flush toilets and hot showers, and year-round camping with winter sites. Changed season: unset -> year_round true. It posts no rates, no site count, no amperage and no booking method beyond its phone number. Note trimmed of the hookup, booking and RV Life rating text.
flags: Long-stay five tests, test 2 (nights really for sale) fails on the operator's own pages: the park sells 'daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal (Summer & Winter) and annual rentals', but its website posts no nightly rate and it has no booking site; an RV Life tier does not stand in for a long-stay park. Only price found is a Campendium camper report of $25/night dated 7/29/24 (a 15-night stay). Presence itself is fine: working website with phone 315-942-4749, and Google Maps shows 4.8 stars from 129 reviews with the same phone.
Website http://www.brownbarncampground.com/ has no working https (the stored URL is http, so it loads).
